mandukya_chapter3_verse3.title: Mandukya Chapter 3 Verse 3
mandukya_chapter3_verse3.introduction: This verse belongs to Mandukya, Chapter 3.
mandukya_chapter3_verse3.scripture_text: A representative contemplative passage from the Mandukya Upanishad, Chapter 3, Verse 3, reflecting the inquiry into Atman, Brahman, and liberation through self-knowledge.
mandukya_chapter3_verse3.philosophical_explanation: This verse extends the contemplative teaching tradition of the Upanishads toward self-knowledge and liberation.
